verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
I surrender all to You, my God
I will give You all I have
For You took my filthiness
And made me clean

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I love You, Lord
Your praises I will sing
Let Heaven shout
For I have been redeemed

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
I lay down my life
My plans, my rights
For I'm captured by Your love
Though I lose this world,
I will know You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Nothing compares
Nothing compares
Nothing compares
Nothing compares
